faq.a: Per DNIT 2024 position: habitual trading gains are subject to IRE at 10%. Occasional trades (1-2/year, no commercial intent) are generally not taxed. Commissions from intermediation are IVA-gravadas at 10%.
Per SEPRELAD Res. 8/20, crypto-related businesses above certain volume thresholds must register, designate a compliance officer, and file ROS reports. We handle the entire process.

faq.q: Can I use Paraguay as a crypto tax haven?
faq.a: Paraguay's territorial system makes foreign-source activity 0% — but crypto trading from PY wallets/exchanges may be considered local. We assess each case to determine the correct position.
Yes. We support BTC, EVM chains (ETH, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism), Solana, Cosmos, and major L1/L2. Cost basis tracked per wallet/chain.
Yes. We accept BTC, ETH, and USDC at official BCP rate on invoice date.

faq.q: Do you coordinate with my home country tax advisor?
faq.a: Yes. Common for US (FATCA/PFIC), UK (CFC), EU (CRS) citizens. We provide documentation that satisfies both PY and home-country requirements.

faq.q: What about NFTs and tokenized assets?
faq.a: Treated case-by-case. Digital collectibles held long-term are typically not gravados; trading activity is. Tokenized real-world assets may fall under securities regulation (CNV).
